story.title: Health and Hygiene
paragraphs_en: There was a village. The village was very dirty. People were sick. No one thought about hygiene. One day some officers came there and they held a meeting to solve the problem. They announced that dustbins would be kept at corners for people to throw waste and people wil not

throw waste in open. All obeyed to the officers but some refused to do that. Next day the dustbins were kept there. But at the evening officers found that there was garbage all around the dustbins. They made a plan to find people who are not obeying. They placed CCTV cameras

near dustbins such that no one can see them and next morning they saw a man throwing garbage outside the dustbin. They held a meeting again and said that some people are not obeying to them. They said that the man who is responsible for this is identified. They will

announce his name publicly tommorrow if he does not pay fine today. The meeting was over. A man came and sat on officers legs and he started crying. He apologised for his mitakes and he promised that he will not do it again. Later the village became clean and tidy.

items.text_en: There was a village.
The village was very dirty.
People were sick.
No one thought about hygiene.
One day some officers came there and they held a meeting to solve the problem.
They announced that dustbins would be kept at corners for people to throw waste and people wil not
throw waste in open.
All obeyed to the officers but some refused to do that.
Next day the dustbins were kept there.
But at the evening officers found that there was garbage all around the dustbins.
They made a plan to find people who are not obeying.
They placed CCTV cameras
near dustbins such that no one can see them and next morning they saw a man throwing garbage outside the dustbin.
They held a meeting again and said that some people are not obeying to them.
They said that the man who is responsible for this is identified. They will
announce his name publicly tommorrow if he does not pay fine today.
The meeting was over.
A man came and sat on officers legs and he started crying.
He apologised for his mitakes and he promised that he will not do it again.
Later the village became clean and tidy.
